# Build your own

Building a PlancH takes four steps:

1. **[Get the components](components.md)**: about 45 parts, most of them cheap and common.
2. **[Order the PCB](ordering.md)**: upload the Gerber ZIP to any PCB maker; only the bare board,
   no assembly service needed.
3. **[Assemble](assembly.md)**: everything is soldered by hand with a regular soldering iron.
   Plan 2–3 hours for the first board.
4. **[Flash the firmware](../firmware/index.md)** and add the board to Home Assistant.

Optionally, print the [desk stand](../accessories/desk-stand.md).

## Skills and tools

You should be comfortable with SMD soldering: 0805 passives, castellated pads and a few
small LEDs. A temperature-controlled iron, flux, fine tweezers and a magnifier are enough; no
hot air station or reflow oven is required. The [assembly guide](assembly.md#tools-and-materials)
has the full list.
